import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input().strip())
    a = list(map(int, input().split()))

    pos1 = a.index(1)
    posn = a.index(n)

    # By one swap, we can move either 1 or n to one of the ends.
    # Check all possibilities and take the maximum resulting distance.
    ans = max(
        abs(0 - posn),         # move 1 to the beginning
        abs((n - 1) - posn),   # move 1 to the end
        abs(pos1 - 0),         # move n to the beginning
        abs(pos1 - (n - 1))    # move n to the end
    )

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
